title: A Phase IIa Trial Evaluating the Efficacy of anti-CD19 Chimeric Antigen Receptor Engineered T-Cells in Patients With Systemic Sclerosis (SSc) Resistant to Immunosuppressive Drugs. SCLEROCAR
official: A Phase IIa Trial Evaluating the Efficacy of anti-CD19 Chimeric Antigen Receptor Engineered T-Cells in Patients With Systemic Sclerosis (SSc) Resistant to Immunosuppressive Drugs. SCLEROCAR
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the clinical efficacy of the CAR T ANTI-CD19 cell therapy on skin fibrosis assessed by mRSS score month 6 after CAR T ANTI-CD19 cell administration in patients with systemic sclerosis resistant to immunosuppressive drugs.
conditions:
Patients will be included with a stable but active disease (as defined Diagnosis of systemic 
sclerosis according to ACR/EULAR classification by EUSTAR ≥2.5) or to patients with a 
worsening disease despite low dose steroids and at least 2 immunosuppressive treatment 
including DMARDs (methotrexate, azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil) and/or a biological 
DMARD (rituximab or tocilizumab) for at least 6 months.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Diagnosis of systemic sclerosis according to ACR/EULAR classification
2. Refractory corresponds to patients with active disease (as defined by EUSTAR ≥2.5) and to patients with a worsening disease despite 6 months of at least 2 immunosuppressive treatments including one DMARDs (methotrexate, azathioprine, mycophenolate mofetil), and one biological DMARD rituximab or tocilizumab.
3. Age: ≥18 ≤65 years old
4. Adequate organ functions assessed within 4 weeks of inclusion:
5. Adequate venous access for apheresis
6. Leucapheresis : a wash-out period of 6 weeks for conventional immunosuppressants (i.e. methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil)
7. Leucapheresis : at least 3 months after biotherapy (i.e. tocilizumab, 6 months for rituximab),
Exclusion criteria:
1. Craniocerebral trauma, conscious disturbance, epilepsy, cerebrovascular ischemia or cerebrovascular hemorrhagic diseases
2. pregnant or breastfeeding women
3. patients with advanced cognitive disorders or any other cause preventing their informed consent
4. ECG showing prolonged QT interval or history of severe heart diseases or FEVG < 40%
5. Lung and / or heart severe dysfunction defined by CVF<50%  and/or  DLCO <40%
6. Pulmonary arterial hypertension defined by catheterism (mean AP > 25mmHg at rest or > 30mmHg after exercise, PAPO < 15mmHG)
7. Active infection (including but not limited to: hepatitis B or C virus or HIV) or covid-19 < 1 months
8. Active hematological or solid neoplasm
9. Methylprednisolone or prednisone (≤20 mg) instead of immunosuppressive agents
10. Rituximab within 6 months to leukapheresis
11. Live vaccines within 30 days prior to leukapheresis
